correctness.rationale: For exact F=x0*x1^2*x2+x1^4+x1*x2^3+x0^3*x3+x0*x2*x3^2 over F2, the 68-line GF64 certificate was read and independently verified using GF(2)[z]/(z^6+z+1). The 68 RREF matrices are distinct, vanish on the quartic at five distinct affine parameters (enough for degree<=4), and every chart Jacobian has full rank: dimension/rank pairs 4/4 on 48,3/3 on 16,1/1 on 3,0/0 on 1. Frobenius squaring yields 4 fixed, 2 two-cycles, 2 three-cycles, 9 six-cycles; cusp plane has two fixed lines and one two-cycle. Independent partial derivatives localize surface singular support at [0:0:0:1]. With the cited published K3-quartic 68-line upper bound and the A3 singularity (published model classification), these 68 are all geometric lines and all local tangent spaces vanish; hence finite étale of degree 68. Orbit counting gives #=4+4*1(2|n)+6*1(3|n)+54*1(6|n) and the asserted zeta product. The GF64 list alone would not prove algebraic-closure completeness without Veniani.
